name: Hayahoshi Akuru
source:
An office worker who spends her days pursuing her 2D husbando. Yet somehow she has the worst luck, and he's the only one she never brings home.

She's so obsessed with the gacha game, she's heading toward financial ruin... But a chance meeting with [url=/c87520]Ren[/url] sets her life tumbling down a totally different path.
